LightningComponentBundle.description: cvp: Flow screen action that navigates to an admin-configured URL. Accepts https or http absolute URLs (no credentials in URL) or a single leading-slash org path. Does not call Apex, store data, or load third-party scripts. Use only trusted Flow logic to set the target URL.

property.name: targetUrl
property.label: Target URL
property.description: Set from trusted Flow logic only. External: full https (recommended) or http URL, no userinfo. Internal: path starting with / (example /lightning/r/Opportunity/006xxx/view).

property.name: openInNewWindow
property.label: Open in new window
property.description: True opens a new browser tab with noopener/noreferrer. False navigates in the same tab after the Flow screen finishes.
